payload.title: Enable editorial checks in the newsroom
payload.description: Turn on the Papyrus editorial-checks plugin (Limatus policies, Jev judgment checks, Luna rewrites) for Threat Intelligence: pin @anthusai/papyrus to the develop prerelease that ships it (2.0.0-next.7: 3.1.0 plus editorial checks) in package.json and infra/site.json, and add backend.plugins: ["editorial-checks"]. TYPESAFE_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY are already Amplify shared secrets on dzefa11i80jyq. Papyrus: PPY-ed678d, AnthusAI/Papyrus#378, #385.
